dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Haha, not bad. Looks like I've got lots of new information...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: New information?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Exactly, exactly! I've got all the latest scoop on things happening outside Inazuma right here — the freshest intel, if you will.

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Have you heard? A giant dragon appeared in Mondstadt to the north some time earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: The dragon's wings were enough to blot out the sun, and it sent furious storms whirling right into the center of Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Hehe, interested? Well, if you wanna hear more, I'm afraid you're going to have to pay up...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's fine, thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Eh, really? You don't need to know?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Alright then, that's your loss!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Do you have something more recent to say?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Huh... Looks like this batch isn't good enough for you.

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Well, how about this, then? Did you know? The ancient god who rules over Liyue lost his life in an unfortunate incident during the annual Rite of Descension!

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: It all happened so suddenly, and the Rite of Descension suddenly turned into the Rite of Parting. Was it a natural disaster? Or some kind of plot?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Would you like to know more? Well, if you're curious, then you've gotta show your appreciation for such detailed intel, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Huh, why do you look so disinterested? Is my information out of date?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Well, I can't help it. Inazuma's been locked down for so long. I had to ask around a lot to find all this intel, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Of course, it's all small beans compared to what a person who's seen the world might know, but among the people of Watatsumi Island, such news is in rather high demand.

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Guess I should do business with locals instead, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: New information?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Exactly, exactly! I've got all the latest scoop on things happening in Inazuma right here — the freshest intel, if you will.

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: I mean, have you heard? The Vision Hunt Decree has been abolished! Those who once had their Visions confiscated can now use their elemental abilities again!

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: You know what? It almost feels like a game, this whole "having elemental abilities" business.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Do you have something more recent to mention?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Huh... Looks like this batch isn't good enough for you.

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Well, how about this then! The Sakoku Decree, enforced for so long, is now finally a thing of the past!

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Will the re-opened sea routes bring hope? Or more foes?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Would you like to know more? Well, if you're curious, then you've gotta show your appreciation for such detailed intel, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Huh, why do you look so disinterested? Is my information out of date?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Am I really always so unlucky as to only meet those who are more familiar with Inazuma than me?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Looks like I need to be better at reading people... But seriously, who am I supposed to look for at this point? Some tourist who doesn't look like they can tell left from right?
